name: deploy-production

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      expected_sha:
        description: Exact certified Git SHA to deploy
        required: true
        type: string
  push:
    branches: [production-release]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 35
    environment: production
    env:
      EXPECTED_SHA: ${{ inputs.expected_sha || github.sha }}
      NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_SHA: ${{ inputs.expected_sha || github.sha }}
      VERCEL_ORG_ID: team_zmEezpOKGZy2sH5nqTfO44LD
      VERCEL_PROJECT_ID: prj_OfVZG87ItRr7Kzw6PJT9Z5ouw04K
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.expected_sha || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Refuse a different SHA
        run: test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_SHA"
      - name: Require production-release push to match current main
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        run: |
          git fetch origin main --depth=1
          test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED_SHA"
      - name: Require Vercel deployment credential
        shell: bash
        env:
          VERCEL_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "${VERCEL_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
            echo "::error::Missing GitHub Actions secret VERCEL_TOKEN. Add a Vercel access token with deployment access to the provenance-cleaner project."
            exit 1
          fi
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24.x
      - run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
      - run: npm i -g vercel@59.10.0
      - name: Pull Production configuration
        run: vercel env pull .env.local --yes --environment=production --token="${VERCEL_TOKEN}" --scope="${VERCEL_ORG_ID}"
        env:
          VERCEL_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }}
      - name: Production configuration preflight
        run: node --env-file=.env.local scripts/predeploy.mjs
      - name: Production release gate
        run: node --env-file=.env.local scripts/release-gate.mjs
      - name: Ensure Stripe TEST Billing Portal
        run: node --env-file=.env.local scripts/configure-stripe-portal.mjs
      - run: npm test
      - run: npm run lint
      - run: npm run build
      - run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - run: npm run test:e2e
      - name: Re-run Production preflight immediately before build
        run: node --env-file=.env.local scripts/predeploy.mjs
      - name: Build exact Production artifact
        run: vercel build --prod --token="${VERCEL_TOKEN}" --scope="${VERCEL_ORG_ID}"
        env:
          VERCEL_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }}
      - name: Deploy exact prebuilt Production artifact
        id: deploy
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          output="$(vercel deploy --prebuilt --prod --yes --token="${VERCEL_TOKEN}" --scope="${VERCEL_ORG_ID}")"
          printf '%s\n' "$output"
          deployment_url="$(printf '%s\n' "$output" | grep -Eo 'https://[^[:space:]]+\.vercel\.app' | tail -n 1)"
          test -n "$deployment_url"
          echo "url=$deployment_url" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
        env:
          VERCEL_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }}
      - name: Verify deployed SHA and public readiness
        env:
          DEPLOYMENT_URL: ${{ steps.deploy.outputs.url }}
        run: node scripts/verify-production.mjs --url "$DEPLOYMENT_URL" --expected-sha "$EXPECTED_SHA" --attempts 12 --delay-ms 5000

# Security checklist

- [x] RLS enabled on private billing/ops tables.
- [x] Billing and operations tables live in non-public schemas.
- [x] Elevated RPCs use fixed empty `search_path` and are revoked from public/anon/authenticated unless explicitly required.
- [x] No authorization uses user-editable `user_metadata`.
- [x] Browser cannot grant credits, select arbitrary Stripe prices, mutate ledger rows or complete purchases.
- [x] Ledger update/delete blocked by trigger.
- [x] Webhook signature verified over raw body before processing.
- [x] Controlled launch blocks live Stripe server keys.
- [x] Guest/edit/Checkout protected by server-side Turnstile verification.
- [x] Production Turnstile bypass is impossible through documented flags.
- [x] API payload size/content type/schema validation centralized.
- [x] Request IDs returned without exposing stack traces/provider errors.
- [x] Raw text/files/cookies/tokens/IPs excluded from application logs.
- [x] CSP restricts framing/object sources and permits only required Turnstile/WASM behavior.
- [x] Dedicated provenance-cleaner Supabase project identified and verified.
- [x] Supabase migrations through Phase 9 applied and independently verified.
- [x] Phase 9 developer API keys persist hashes only, require verified accounts, support revocation, and enforce an atomic active-key cap.
- [x] Supabase security advisors reviewed after Phase 9 verification.
- [x] `package-lock.json` committed and CI uses `npm ci`.
- [x] CI verified on GitHub-hosted runners.
- [x] Full Playwright browser suite and deployment-readiness certification verified.
- [x] Exact-SHA Vercel production workflow fails closed when deployment credentials are missing.
- [x] Service worker excludes `/api/*` from offline caching.
- [x] Chrome extension stores preferences/API key only; selected source/result text is memory-only.
- [ ] Enable Supabase Auth leaked-password protection before broad public rollout.
- [x] Production has a tokenless authorized fallback: OAuth source-fingerprint deployment from the exact certified GitHub tree.
- [ ] Add GitHub Actions `VERCEL_TOKEN` to the `production` environment if automated CLI deployments are desired; this is no longer a Production launch blocker.
- [ ] Enable GitHub branch protection/rulesets for `main` with required CI checks and pull-request review; the current branch is not protected.
- [ ] Activate an Admin owner/bootstrap identity when operational Admin access is required; this is intentionally non-blocking for customer-facing readiness.

name: prepare-oauth-production-payload

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      expected_sha:
        description: Exact certified Git SHA to package
        required: true
        type: string
  push:
    branches: [production-release]

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  prepare:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    env:
      EXPECTED_SHA: ${{ inputs.expected_sha || github.sha }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.expected_sha || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24.x
      - name: Refuse a different SHA
        run: test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_SHA"
      - name: Require production-release push to match current main
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        run: |
          git fetch origin main --depth=1
          test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED_SHA"
      - name: Verify certified source manifest
        run: npm run release:manifest:check
      - name: Generate bounded OAuth payload
        run: npm run release:oauth:pack
      - name: Publish temporary payload branch
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git checkout -B oauth-production-payload
          git add -f release/oauth-bundle-*.json
          git commit -m "chore: prepare OAuth payload for ${EXPECTED_SHA}"
          git push --force origin HEAD:oauth-production-payload

# Provenance Cleaner Safe Editor — Chrome

This Manifest V3 extension provides in-place protected rewriting for selected text.

## What it does

- Uses the same `/api/v1/transform` endpoint as other developer clients.
- Supports mode, purpose, and rewrite intensity.
- Replaces selected text in `input`, `textarea`, and `contenteditable` surfaces.
- Keeps a single in-memory undo record for the last page edit.
- Shows a copyable result for read-only selections.
- Stores only the developer API key, API base URL, and preferences in `chrome.storage.local`.
- Does **not** store selected source text or generated output.

## Local installation

1. Open `chrome://extensions`.
2. Enable Developer mode.
3. Choose **Load unpacked** and select `extension/chrome`.
4. Create a developer API key from the Provenance Cleaner Account page.
5. Paste that key into the extension popup and save settings.

The production host permission is limited to `https://provenance-cleaner.vercel.app/*`; localhost is also allowed for development.
